note: Registry of external sources: repositories, files, REST APIs and MCP servers. Pipelines and the Worker read URLs from here (or from environment overrides), so swapping a source is a config change. Every harvested file is recorded in data/<scope>/manifest.json with its source_id, retrieval time and SHA-256.

sources.title: National veteran resource directory (REST API and MCP server)
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (attribution required; the attribution text comes from each response's _meta block)
sources.used_for: Directory search, crisis routing, benefits references, county resource counts (targets), and LLM chat with crisis detection
sources.exclude_reason: Fundraising and publisher-profile tools are specific to the upstream operator, not to veteran services

sources.title: County industry levels by NAICS (pre-processed County Business Patterns)
sources.license: Derived from U.S. Census Bureau public-domain data
sources.used_for: Default industry features: employees, establishments and payroll per county and sector
sources.notes: Fixed upstream in October 2026: naics2 files now include sectors 31 (31-33), 44 (44-45) and 48 (48-49). The pipeline reads naics2 and cross-checks it against a naics4 rollup.

sources.title: Harmonized System to NAICS lookup
sources.used_for: Linking county industries to traded products (HS 4-digit to NAICS 4-digit)

sources.title: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File Extract
sources.used_for: Veteran-serving organizations: NTEE codes W30 (military and veterans organizations) and IRC subsection 19 (posts of past or present members of the armed forces)

sources.title: County Business Patterns, county file
sources.used_for: Industry levels by county (NAICS): employees, establishments and annual payroll, with noise and suppression flags

sources.title: 2020 ZCTA to County Relationship File
sources.used_for: Assigning a ZIP code to the county holding the largest share of its land area, with that share kept as match confidence

sources.title: American Community Survey 5-year, table B21001 (Sex by Age by Veteran Status)
